query: What are the four risk categories for AI systems defined in the EU AI Act?
answer: The EU AI Act classifies AI systems into four risk tiers: (1) unacceptable risk (prohibited, e.g. social scoring, real-time biometric identification), (2) high risk (subject to strict requirements, e.g. critical infrastructure, employment, law enforcement), (3) limited risk (transparency obligations, e.g. chatbots, deepfakes), and (4) minimal/no risk (freely permitted).
